concepts.source_evidence: 5 PRIME TIME 5.1 Common Multiples and Common Factors Idli-Vada Game Children sit in a circle and play a game of numbers.

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Support a conclusion with source information or valid working.
concepts.source_evidence: But when it is the turn of 3, 6, 9, … (multiples of 3), the player should say ‘idli’ instead of the number.
